intent: Show the rain shadow collapsing into Australia's vast arid interior: clouds die at the range, then an animated rainfall-band diagram reveals the 82% dry expanse exceeding the 500 mm line and dwarfing Western Europe.

beats.action: Dark eastern ridgeline stands on the left; dense cloud band pushes westward against it.
Clouds thin and fade as they cross the ridge — beyond it the sky empties and a red arid band begins spreading across the continent.
Green coastal fringe shrinks to a sliver while the red expanse labels itself '82%' with the 500 mm threshold line holding its edge; hold for the cut.

handoff.opening: Opens deliberately on a built schematic ridge-and-cloud barrier, inheriting the mountain topic from the previous scene but replacing footage with an explanatory graphic.
handoff.endState: Ridge at left, near-empty sky beyond it, red landmass filling most of frame with '82%' counter at 82 and '500 mm' line fixed; motion frozen in a clean hold.
handoff.motionVector: Left-to-right exhaustion of moisture — the red expanse continues pressing toward the next scene's desert imagery.
handoff.nextOpportunity: The rigid red mass could hard-cut into real outback/desert footage carrying the same left-edge barrier line.
